dogecoin.text: As per CoinDesk, Bitcoin prices were trading higher at $47,583. Ether, the coin linked to ethereum blockchain, was also trading with minor gains at $3,309.6. Dogecoin, on the other hand, surged over 9% to $0.33.
The total market value of cryptocurrencies rose above $2 trillion again as Bitcoin continued to climb and the likes of Cardano, XRP and Dogecoin advanced as well during the weekend.

Bitcoin above $47,000, dogecoin surges over 9%
